q: Delhi Metro International Limited (DMIL), set up to expand metro consultancy, operations and maintenance business in India and overseas, is a wholly owned subsidiary of the:

options.C: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

e: Delhi Metro International Limited is a wholly owned subsidiary of the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation Limited, set up to expand metro consultancy, operations and maintenance business in India and overseas.

q: Pipavav Railway Corporation Limited (PRCL), the first public-private partnership special purpose vehicle of the Ministry of Railways, was formed as a joint venture of the Ministry of Railways with:

options.A: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited

e: Pipavav Railway Corporation Limited, the first PPP special purpose vehicle of the Ministry of Railways, was formed as a joint venture of the Ministry of Railways with Gujarat Pipavav Port Limited.

q: Haryana Orbital Rail Corporation Limited (HORCL), the special purpose vehicle implementing the Haryana Orbital Rail Corridor, is executing the orbital line from Palwal to:
e: Haryana Orbital Rail Corporation Limited is executing the Haryana Orbital Rail Corridor from Palwal to Sonipat, passing around Delhi to decongest the capital's rail network.

q: In the Jharkhand Rail Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited (JRIDCL), the joint venture for developing railway infrastructure in Jharkhand, the majority equity of 51 per cent is held by the:
e: In Jharkhand Rail Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited, the Government of Jharkhand holds the majority equity of 51 per cent, with the Railways side holding the rest.

q: The joint venture company formed by the Government of Madhya Pradesh with the Ministry of Railways for expansion of the railway network in the State, with the State Government holding 51 per cent equity, is the:

options.A: Madhya Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Limited
options.B: Madhya Pradesh Rail Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited
options.C: Maharashtra Rail Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited
options.D: Madhya Pradesh Road Development Corporation Limited

e: The joint venture with the State Government holding 51 per cent equity for railway network expansion in Madhya Pradesh is the Madhya Pradesh Rail Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited.

q: CONCOR Last Mile Logistics Limited, incorporated in January 2020 to develop goods sheds, manage freight terminals and provide first mile-last mile connectivity, is a wholly owned subsidiary of the:
e: CONCOR Last Mile Logistics Limited, incorporated in January 2020 for goods sheds, freight terminals and first mile-last mile connectivity, is a wholly owned subsidiary of Container Corporation of India Limited.

q: HSRC Infra Services Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Rail Vikas Nigam Limited (RVNL) engaged in project management consultancy, was earlier known as the:

options.A: High Speed Rail Corporation of India Limited
options.B: National High Speed Rail Corporation Limited

e: HSRC Infra Services Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of RVNL, was earlier known as High Speed Rail Corporation of India Limited before its name and role were changed.

q: KRIBHCO Infrastructure Limited (KRIL), a container train operator licensed by Indian Railways which also runs private freight terminals at places like Hazira, Pali and Modinagar, was set up as a wholly owned subsidiary of:
e: KRIBHCO Infrastructure Limited, a container train operator running private freight terminals at Hazira, Pali and Modinagar, was set up as a wholly owned subsidiary of Krishak Bharati Cooperative Limited.

q: The Electric Loco Shed at Tughlakabad in Delhi, which homes WAP and WAG class electric locomotives, functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Electric Loco Shed at Tughlakabad in Delhi, homing WAP and WAG class electric locomotives, functions under West Central Railway.

q: The Electric Loco Shed at New Katni Junction functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Electric Loco Shed at New Katni Junction functions under West Central Railway, as Katni is a major junction of that zone.

q: The Electric Loco Shed at Tatanagar functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Electric Loco Shed at Tatanagar functions under South Eastern Railway, as Tatanagar is in the Chakradharpur division of that zone.

q: The Electric Loco Shed at Gomoh in Jharkhand functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Electric Loco Shed at Gomoh in Jharkhand functions under East Central Railway, as Gomoh lies in the Dhanbad division of that zone.

q: The Electric Loco Shed at Lallaguda in Hyderabad functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Electric Loco Shed at Lallaguda in Hyderabad functions under South Central Railway.

q: The Electric Loco Shed at Arakkonam in Tamil Nadu functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Electric Loco Shed at Arakkonam in Tamil Nadu functions under Southern Railway.

q: The Electric Loco Shed at Vadodara functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Electric Loco Shed at Vadodara functions under Western Railway.

q: The Electric Loco Shed at Bhusawal functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Electric Loco Shed at Bhusawal functions under Central Railway, as Bhusawal is a division of Central Railway.

q: The Diesel Loco Shed at Hubballi functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Diesel Loco Shed at Hubballi functions under South Western Railway, whose headquarters is at Hubballi.

q: The Diesel Loco Shed at New Guwahati functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Diesel Loco Shed at New Guwahati functions under Northeast Frontier Railway.

q: The Diesel Loco Shed at Abu Road in Rajasthan functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Diesel Loco Shed at Abu Road in Rajasthan functions under North Western Railway, in its Ajmer division.

q: In the Freight Operations Information System (FOIS) of Indian Railways, the module 'RMS', which deals with rake placement, indenting and movement of freight trains, stands for:
e: In FOIS, RMS stands for Rake Management System, the module dealing with rake placement, indenting and movement of freight trains.

q: In Indian Railways freight booking, the facility 'e-RD', through which freight customers register their demand for wagons or rakes online through FOIS, stands for:
e: In FOIS freight booking, e-RD stands for Electronic Registration of Demand, through which freight customers register their demand for wagons or rakes online.

q: In railway freight charging, the special concessional rates notified for traffic between specified pairs of stations are denoted by 'STS', which stands for:
e: In railway freight charging, STS stands for Station-to-Station Rates, the special concessional rates notified for traffic between specified pairs of stations.

q: In the freight marketing policy of Indian Railways, the scheme 'SFTO', under which private operators invest in high-capacity special purpose rakes for carrying bulk commodities, stands for:
e: SFTO stands for Special Freight Train Operator Scheme, under which private operators invest in high-capacity special purpose rakes for bulk commodities.

q: In the freight marketing policy of Indian Railways, the scheme 'AFTO', under which operators invest in and run automobile carrier rakes, stands for:
e: AFTO stands for Automobile Freight Train Operator Scheme, under which operators invest in and run automobile carrier rakes.

q: In the freight investment schemes of Indian Railways, the scheme 'GPWIS', under which freight customers invest in general purpose wagons and earn freight rebates, stands for:

options.C: Goods and Parcel Wagon Integration System

e: GPWIS stands for General Purpose Wagon Investment Scheme, under which freight customers invest in general purpose wagons and earn freight rebates.

q: In suburban and passenger commercial working, the season ticket issued for a calendar month and denoted by 'MST' stands for:
e: In suburban and passenger commercial working, MST stands for Monthly Season Ticket, issued for a calendar month for regular travel.

q: In railway passenger commercial working, the authorised agents appointed to issue reserved tickets, denoted by 'RTSA', stands for:
e: RTSA stands for Rail Travel Service Agent, the authorised agents appointed to issue reserved tickets.

q: The scheme of Indian Railways for generating revenue from innovative non-tariff sources such as advertising and branding rights is denoted by 'NINFRIS', which stands for:

options.A: National Innovative Non-Fare Receipt Initiative Scheme
options.C: New Innovative Non-Fare Revenue Ideas Scheme
options.D: New Indian Non-Fare Revenue Improvement System

e: NINFRIS stands for New Innovative Non-Fare Revenue Ideas Scheme, the scheme for generating revenue from innovative non-tariff sources such as advertising and branding rights.

q: In railway signalling provided for train operations, the system 'MACLS' stands for:

options.D: Manual Aspect Control and Lighting System

e: MACLS stands for Multiple Aspect Colour Light Signalling, the signalling system using colour light signals with multiple aspects for train operations.

q: In the remote control of traction power supply and other railway installations, the computerised control and monitoring system 'SCADA' stands for:
e: SCADA stands for Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition, the computerised system for remote control and monitoring of traction power supply and other installations.

q: The new Jammu railway division, inaugurated by the Prime Minister in January 2025 after being carved out of the Firozpur division, functions under which zonal railway?
e: The new Jammu railway division, inaugurated in January 2025 after being carved out of the Firozpur division, functions under Northern Railway.

q: The first section of Delhi Metro's Phase-IV, inaugurated in January 2025, was the extension of the Magenta Line from Janakpuri West to:
e: The first section of Delhi Metro Phase-IV inaugurated in January 2025 was the Magenta Line extension from Janakpuri West to Krishna Park Extension.

q: Mumbai's first underground metro section, Phase-1 of the Aqua Line (Metro Line-3) inaugurated in October 2024, was opened between Aarey JVLR and:
e: Mumbai's first underground metro section, Phase-1 of the Aqua Line or Metro Line-3 inaugurated in October 2024, was opened between Aarey JVLR and Bandra Kurla Complex.

q: The Chennai Metro Rail Project Phase-II, approved by the Union Cabinet in October 2024 at a completion cost of Rs 63,246 crore, comprises how many corridors?
e: Chennai Metro Rail Phase-II, approved by the Union Cabinet in October 2024 at a completion cost of Rs 63,246 crore, comprises three corridors.

q: The Kavi Subhash-Hemanta Mukhopadhyay section, inaugurated in March 2024, forms part of which line of the Kolkata Metro?
e: The Kavi Subhash-Hemanta Mukhopadhyay section inaugurated in March 2024 forms part of the Orange Line of the Kolkata Metro.

q: In March 2024, the Prime Minister flagged off a batch of new Vande Bharat Express trains from Ahmedabad at one function. The number of new Vande Bharat trains flagged off on that occasion was:
e: In March 2024 the Prime Minister flagged off ten new Vande Bharat Express trains at one function from Ahmedabad.

q: One of the three Vande Bharat Express trains flagged off by the Prime Minister on 31 August 2024 connects Chennai Egmore with:
e: One of the three Vande Bharat Express trains flagged off on 31 August 2024 connects Chennai Egmore with Nagercoil.

q: The six Vande Bharat Express trains flagged off by the Prime Minister in September 2024 included a service between Tatanagar and:
e: The six Vande Bharat Express trains flagged off in September 2024 included a service between Tatanagar and Patna.

q: In November 2024, the Prime Minister inaugurated Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Jan Aushadhi Kendras at railway stations across the country. The number of Kendras inaugurated on that occasion was:
e: In November 2024 the Prime Minister inaugurated 18 Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Jan Aushadhi Kendras at railway stations across the country, for affordable generic medicines.

q: In August 2024, the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs approved new railway line projects of Indian Railways spread over seven States, which will increase the existing railway network by about:
e: In August 2024 the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs approved eight new railway line projects across seven States, which will increase the existing railway network by about 900 kilometres.

q: Mumbai Metro Line-5, the elevated corridor connecting Thane with Bhiwandi and Kalyan, is being implemented by which authority?
e: Mumbai Metro Line-5, the elevated corridor connecting Thane with Bhiwandi and Kalyan, is being implemented by the Mumbai Metropolitan Region Development Authority.

q: The operation and maintenance of Mumbai Metro Line-2A (Dahisar East to D. N. Nagar) and Line-7 (Dahisar East to Gundavali) is carried out by which corporation?

options.C: Maha Mumbai Metro Operation Corporation Limited

e: Operation and maintenance of Mumbai Metro Line-2A and Line-7 is carried out by Maha Mumbai Metro Operation Corporation Limited.

q: The Navi Mumbai Metro, whose Line-1 runs from Belapur to Pendhar, is owned by which organisation?
e: The Navi Mumbai Metro, whose Line-1 runs from Belapur to Pendhar, is owned by the City and Industrial Development Corporation, CIDCO.

q: The Chennai Unified Metropolitan Transport Authority (CUMTA), the body set up to coordinate all transport agencies in the Chennai Metropolitan Area, was established under an Act passed in the year:
e: The Chennai Unified Metropolitan Transport Authority was established under the CUMTA Act passed in 2010, to coordinate transport agencies in the Chennai Metropolitan Area.

q: The Kerala Rapid Transit Corporation Limited (KRTCL), the special purpose vehicle formed for the light metro projects of Thiruvananthapuram and Kozhikode, was earlier known as the:
e: Kerala Rapid Transit Corporation Limited, the SPV for the Thiruvananthapuram and Kozhikode light metro projects, was earlier known as Kerala Monorail Corporation Limited.

q: The proposed metro corridor connecting Dehradun, Rishikesh and Haridwar in Uttarakhand is to be executed by which special purpose vehicle?

options.C: Uttarakhand Metro Rail, Urban Infrastructure and Building Construction Corporation Limited

e: The proposed metro corridor connecting Dehradun, Rishikesh and Haridwar is to be executed by Uttarakhand Metro Rail, Urban Infrastructure and Building Construction Corporation Limited.

q: The Thane Integral Ring Metro Rail Project, approved by the Union Cabinet in August 2024, will be executed by which agency?
e: The Thane Integral Ring Metro Rail Project, approved by the Union Cabinet in August 2024, will be executed by Maharashtra Metro Rail Corporation Limited, Maha Metro.

q: The Chennai Mass Rapid Transit System (MRTS), the elevated urban rail system running from Chennai Beach towards St. Thomas Mount, is operated by which zonal railway?
e: The Chennai Mass Rapid Transit System, the elevated urban rail system from Chennai Beach towards St. Thomas Mount, is operated by Southern Railway.

q: The Hyderabad Multi-Modal Transport System (MMTS), the suburban rail system of Hyderabad which is a joint venture of the State Government and the Railways, is operated by which zonal railway?
e: The Hyderabad Multi-Modal Transport System, the suburban rail system of Hyderabad run as a joint venture of the State Government and the Railways, is operated by South Central Railway.

q: The Kolkata Circular Railway, the loop line encircling the city of Kolkata, is operated by the Sealdah division of which zonal railway?
e: The Kolkata Circular Railway, the loop line encircling Kolkata, is operated by the Sealdah division of Eastern Railway.

q: Delhi Integrated Multi-Modal Transit System Limited (DIMTS), the urban transport company of Delhi, is an equal equity joint venture of the Government of NCT of Delhi with which organisation?

options.D: Infrastructure Leasing and Financial Services Limited

e: Delhi Integrated Multi-Modal Transit System Limited is an equal equity joint venture of the Government of NCT of Delhi with IDFC Foundation.

q: For the manufacture and long-term maintenance of Vande Bharat Sleeper trainsets for Indian Railways, Titagarh Rail Systems Limited has formed a consortium with which public sector undertaking?

options.C: Rail India Technical and Economic Service Limited

e: For manufacture and long-term maintenance of Vande Bharat Sleeper trainsets, Titagarh Rail Systems Limited has formed a consortium with Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited.

q: The Metro Neo system, a mass transit system using rubber-tyred electric coaches drawing power from an overhead conductor rail, was first proposed in India for the city of:
e: Metro Neo, the rubber-tyred electric coach system drawing power from an overhead conductor rail, was first proposed in India for the city of Nashik.

q: The Electric Loco Shed at Asansol in West Bengal functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Electric Loco Shed at Asansol in West Bengal functions under Eastern Railway.

q: The Electric Loco Shed at Bardhaman in West Bengal functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Electric Loco Shed at Bardhaman in West Bengal functions under Eastern Railway.

q: The Electric Loco Shed at Santragachi, near Howrah, functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Electric Loco Shed at Santragachi, near Howrah, functions under South Eastern Railway.

q: The Electric Loco Shed at Bokaro Steel City in Jharkhand functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Electric Loco Shed at Bokaro Steel City in Jharkhand functions under South Eastern Railway, in its Adra division.

q: The Electric and Diesel Loco Shed at Pt. Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Junction (Mughalsarai) functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Electric and Diesel Loco Shed at Pt. Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Junction, formerly Mughalsarai, functions under East Central Railway.

q: The Diesel Loco Shed at Gonda in Uttar Pradesh functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Diesel Loco Shed at Gonda in Uttar Pradesh functions under North Eastern Railway.

q: The Electric Loco Shed at Kalyan in Maharashtra, among the oldest electric loco sheds of Indian Railways, functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Electric Loco Shed at Kalyan in Maharashtra, among the oldest electric loco sheds of Indian Railways, functions under Central Railway.

q: The Diesel Loco Shed at Pune in Maharashtra functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Diesel Loco Shed at Pune in Maharashtra functions under Central Railway.

q: The Electric Loco Shed at Kazipet in Telangana functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Electric Loco Shed at Kazipet in Telangana functions under South Central Railway.

q: The Diesel Loco Shed at Tondiarpet in Chennai functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Diesel Loco Shed at Tondiarpet in Chennai functions under Southern Railway.

q: The Electric and Diesel Loco Shed at Raipur in Chhattisgarh functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Electric and Diesel Loco Shed at Raipur in Chhattisgarh functions under South East Central Railway.

q: In metro and suburban train operations, the signalling system 'CBTC', which controls train movement through continuous radio communication between the train and the trackside equipment, stands for:
e: CBTC stands for Communications-Based Train Control, the signalling system controlling train movement through continuous radio communication between train and trackside equipment.

q: In railway rolling stock maintenance, the trackside equipment 'WILD', which detects defective wheels of passing trains by measuring the impact loads on the rails, stands for:
e: WILD stands for Wheel Impact Load Detector, the trackside equipment that detects defective wheels of passing trains by measuring impact loads on the rails.

q: In railway train operations, the safety system 'AWS', which warns the loco pilot on approaching a signal and applies the brakes if the warning is not acknowledged, stands for:
e: AWS stands for Automatic Warning System, which warns the loco pilot on approaching a signal and applies the brakes if the warning is not acknowledged.

q: In railway signalling, the train control standard 'ETCS', developed in Europe and adopted for interoperability of trains across networks, stands for:
e: ETCS stands for European Train Control System, the European standard developed for interoperability of trains across networks.

q: In metro train operations, the mode 'ATO', under which the train accelerates, coasts and brakes automatically between stations while the driver supervises and operates the doors, stands for:
e: ATO stands for Automatic Train Operation, the mode under which the train accelerates, coasts and brakes automatically between stations while the driver supervises and operates the doors.

q: In Indian Railways long-haul freight operations, the wireless system 'DPWCS', which allows the locomotives distributed along a long train to be controlled simultaneously from the leading locomotive, stands for:
e: DPWCS stands for Distributed Power Wireless Control System, which allows locomotives distributed along a long train to be controlled simultaneously from the leading locomotive.

q: In railway operating statistics, the abbreviation 'SEC', which measures the energy consumed for hauling a specified quantum of traffic, stands for:
e: SEC stands for Specific Energy Consumption, which measures the energy consumed for hauling a specified quantum of traffic.

q: At railway stations, the display and announcement system 'PIS', which provides passengers with information about train arrivals, departures and coach positions, stands for:
e: PIS stands for Passenger Information System, the display and announcement system giving passengers information on train arrivals, departures and coach positions.

q: In railway signalling provided to increase the line capacity of a section, the system 'ABS', under which the section is divided into small sub-sections each protected by an automatic signal, stands for:
e: ABS stands for Automatic Block Signalling, under which a section is divided into small sub-sections each protected by an automatic signal to increase line capacity.

q: In modern railway signalling, the interlocking system 'EI', in which the functions earlier performed by relays are carried out by electronic and computer-based equipment, stands for:
e: EI stands for Electronic Interlocking, in which functions earlier performed by relays are carried out by electronic and computer-based equipment.

q: In railway reservation charts, the waiting list code 'RSWL', allotted for journeys from the originating station to intermediate roadside stations, stands for:
e: RSWL stands for Roadside Station Waiting List, allotted in reservation charts for journeys from the originating station to intermediate roadside stations.

q: The Phase-1B of the Kochi Metro, inaugurated by the Prime Minister in March 2024, extended metro services from S. N. Junction to which new terminal station?
e: Phase-1B of the Kochi Metro, inaugurated in March 2024, extended metro services from S. N. Junction to Tripunithura Terminal.

q: The Taratala-Majerhat section of the Kolkata Metro, inaugurated in March 2024, extended the Purple Line (Joka line) up to which station?
e: The Taratala-Majerhat section inaugurated in March 2024 extended the Kolkata Metro Purple Line up to Majerhat station.

q: The Pune Metro stretch inaugurated by the Prime Minister in March 2024 extended metro services from Ruby Hall Clinic up to which station?
e: The Pune Metro stretch inaugurated in March 2024 extended metro services from Ruby Hall Clinic up to Ramwadi.

q: One of the ten Vande Bharat Express trains flagged off by the Prime Minister on 12 March 2024 gave the capital of Uttarakhand, Dehradun, a direct Vande Bharat connection with which city?
e: One of the ten Vande Bharat trains flagged off on 12 March 2024 connected Dehradun, capital of Uttarakhand, directly with Lucknow.

q: The Inderlok-Indraprastha corridor of Delhi Metro Phase-IV, approved by the Union Cabinet in March 2024, is an extension of which line of the Delhi Metro?
e: The Inderlok-Indraprastha corridor of Delhi Metro Phase-IV, approved in March 2024, is an extension of the Green Line.

q: In August 2024, the Union Cabinet approved Phase-3 of the metro rail project, comprising corridors from J. P. Nagar to Kempapura and from Hosahalli to Kadabagere, of which city?
e: In August 2024 the Union Cabinet approved Phase-3 of the Bengaluru metro, comprising corridors from J. P. Nagar to Kempapura and from Hosahalli to Kadabagere.

q: The extension of the Pune Metro Phase-1 line approved by the Union Cabinet in August 2024 will take the metro from Swargate up to which place?
e: The Pune Metro Phase-1 extension approved in August 2024 will take the metro from Swargate up to Katraj.

q: The new rail-cum-road bridge across the Ganga at Varanasi, approved by the Union Cabinet in October 2024 as part of the Varanasi-Pt. Deen Dayal Upadhyaya multi-tracking project, will supplement which existing bridge?
e: The new rail-cum-road bridge across the Ganga at Varanasi, approved in October 2024, will supplement the existing Malviya Bridge on the Varanasi-Pt. Deen Dayal Upadhyaya section.

q: One of the three Vande Bharat Express trains flagged off by the Prime Minister on 31 August 2024 connected the temple city of Madurai with which station of Bengaluru?
e: One of the three Vande Bharat trains flagged off on 31 August 2024 connected Madurai with Bengaluru Cantonment station.

q: The first full-fledged trial run of the Kolkata Metro Yellow Line, conducted in January 2025, was carried out from Noapara up to which airport station?
e: The first full-fledged trial run of the Kolkata Metro Yellow Line in January 2025 was carried out from Noapara up to Jai Hind Biman Bandar, the airport station.

q: Indian Railways conducted a pilot study on shifting from cash-based to accrual-based accounting with the help of the Accounting Research Foundation of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India. The pilot was implemented at which division, along with its group of workshops, of North Western Railway?
e: Indian Railways engaged the Accounting Research Foundation of ICAI for the accrual accounting pilot, implemented at Ajmer division along with its group of workshops in North Western Railway.

q: The Central Railside Warehouse Company Limited (CRWC), a Mini-Ratna Central Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Railways, has been merged into its holding enterprise:
e: The Central Railside Warehouse Company Limited, a Mini-Ratna CPSE under the Ministry of Railways, has been merged into its holding enterprise, the Central Warehousing Corporation.

q: In the Chhattisgarh Railway Corporation Limited, a joint venture formed to develop railway infrastructure in Chhattisgarh, the majority equity stake of 51 per cent is held by the:
e: In Chhattisgarh Railway Corporation Limited, the Government of Chhattisgarh holds the majority equity stake of 51 per cent for developing railway infrastructure in the State.

q: Under the Memorandum of Understanding signed in March 2015 between Indian Railways and the Life Insurance Corporation of India, LIC agreed to provide financial assistance for railway projects over five years up to:
e: Under the March 2015 MoU between Indian Railways and LIC, LIC agreed to provide financial assistance for railway projects over five years up to Rs 1.5 lakh crore.

q: The 'Joint Parcel Product', later named the Rail Post Gati Shakti Express Cargo Service, under which first-mile and last-mile connectivity is provided by road and the middle leg is carried by rail, is a joint service of Indian Railways and the:
e: The Joint Parcel Product, later named Rail Post Gati Shakti Express Cargo Service, is a joint service of Indian Railways and the Department of Posts, with road first and last mile and rail middle leg.

q: Under its Rail Logistics Project approved in June 2022, the World Bank extended a loan of US$ 245 million to strengthen which organisation as a commercial multi-modal logistics provider along the Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridor?

options.A: Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited

e: Under its Rail Logistics Project approved in June 2022, the World Bank extended a US$ 245 million loan to strengthen Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited as a commercial multi-modal logistics provider along the Eastern DFC.

q: The Sagarmala Development Company Limited, incorporated in 2016 as the nodal agency for port-led development under the Sagarmala Programme, functions under the administrative control of the:

options.B: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
options.C: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways

e: Sagarmala Development Company Limited, incorporated in 2016 as the nodal agency for port-led development under Sagarmala, functions under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways.

q: The US$ 500 million green bonds issued by the Indian Railway Finance Corporation became, in January 2018, the first debt security to be listed on a stock exchange at the International Financial Services Centre (IFSC) in GIFT City. The bonds were listed on the:
e: IRFC's US$ 500 million green bonds became in January 2018 the first debt security listed at the IFSC in GIFT City, listed on India International Exchange, India INX.

q: The Railway Women's Welfare Central Organisation (RWWCO), the apex body of women's welfare organisations on Indian Railways working for the welfare of railwaymen and their families, commenced its activities in the year:
e: The Railway Women's Welfare Central Organisation, the apex body of women's welfare organisations on Indian Railways, started its activities in 1962 after the Indo-China war.

q: Which was the first public sector undertaking of Indian Railways to be listed on the stock exchanges through an initial public offer, in 2018?

options.D: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Limited

e: RITES Limited was the first public sector undertaking of Indian Railways to be listed on the stock exchanges through an initial public offer, in 2018.

q: The Railway Design Centre, set up in 2015 to promote passenger-friendly design of coaches, stations and other railway products, functions at the:

options.D: School of Planning and Architecture, New Delhi

e: The Railway Design Centre, set up in 2015 to promote passenger-friendly design of coaches, stations and other railway products, functions at the National Institute of Design, Ahmedabad.

q: The headquarters of the International Union of Railways (UIC), the worldwide organisation of railways founded in 1922, is located in:
e: The headquarters of the International Union of Railways, UIC, the worldwide railway organisation founded in 1922, is located in Paris.

q: For the redevelopment of 10 railway stations to global standards, the Rail Land Development Authority (RLDA) signed a Memorandum of Understanding with which Navratna Central Public Sector Undertaking?
e: For redevelopment of 10 railway stations to global standards, the Rail Land Development Authority signed an MoU with NBCC (India) Limited, a Navratna CPSE.

q: Fairlie Place in Kolkata is the headquarters building of which zonal railway?
e: Fairlie Place in Kolkata is the headquarters building of Eastern Railway.

q: The headquarters of the South Eastern Railway is located at which place in Kolkata?
e: The headquarters of South Eastern Railway is located at Garden Reach in Kolkata.
